searches.reason: Turn bounded export checks into an audit of the actual deployment path. Seek independently verified fault injections and harmless controls for wrong category routing, stale checkpoints, item-map permutations, missing appended masks and incorrect left-padding readouts. Compare the exported predictor with the same selected checkpoint, without fitting another model; report score agreement and ranking agreement separately.

searches.reason: Move beyond generic history deletion toward tests that distinguish sensitivity to recent, repeated evidence from sensitivity to broad similarity and popularity. Seek frequency-matched history substitutions and order interventions using training histories only, with unchanged candidates, explicit positional controls and paired uncertainty. These measure model dependence rather than causal user intent and can motivate specific masking, position-encoding or loss experiments within one BERT4Rec model per category.

searches.reason: Connect qualitative rejection feedback to trustworthy measurements. Seek annotation protocols separating immediate choice, broad relevance, redundancy, explicit specification mismatch and insufficient information, with evidence spans, abstention and inter-rater agreement. Use only available titles, descriptions, histories and explicit feedback; validate automated proxies against bounded annotations without inferring ownership, compatibility or simulator traits. Keep these diagnostic outcomes separate from the pinned macro validation HR@10.
